fields.name: init_data_a
fields.meaning: Program data filled from the cartridge at a fresh start (no valid key); kept as-is when a suspended game is resumed
fields.evidence: boot code 8000:004B copies 0x3C8 bytes from ROM C000:0000 only when the key does not match; save image matches the cartridge bytes except the live words

fields.name: random_seed
fields.meaning: Random number state used by the game (changes almost every frame); restored on resume
fields.evidence: code 82AA:0505 (next = seed*0x41C64E6D+0x3039, returns top 15 bits); boot reads it before anything writes it

fields.name: unknown_0016
fields.meaning: Not decoded (read at power-on, zero in every save image)
fields.evidence: boot read at 8330:0027; zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: display_layers
fields.meaning: Copy of which screen layers (background, foreground, sprites) are switched on, one word each
fields.evidence: code 82FE:028C-02D6 writes these words to the display control port; boot reads before writes

fields.name: init_data_b
fields.meaning: Rest of the program data filled from the cartridge at a fresh start; not decoded field by field
fields.evidence: boot code 8000:004B range; unchanged against the cartridge bytes

fields.name: resume_key
fields.meaning: Save marker: the Shift-JIS text for the Go keyword phrase. Written only by the save-and-quit menu command. At power-on it is compared with the copy in the cartridge program: if equal the game resumes from memory, otherwise all memory from 0x01E4 to 0xCAD3 is cleared and a new session starts. Either way it is overwritten with 0xFF right after the check, so a suspended game can be resumed once
fields.evidence: code 8000:0122 (write, from ROM 8000:0145), 8000:002B (compare at boot), 8000:0038 (wipe to FF); appears only in the four suspended-game images

fields.name: reserved_0204
fields.meaning: Reserved; zero in every save image
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: halted_after_save
fields.meaning: 1 after save-and-quit: the main loop stops running the game so the player can switch off. Reset to 0 at every power-on
fields.evidence: code 8C79:03EA (set after the key is written), 8000:00CF (cleared at boot), 8000:010F (main loop test); 0 before saving, 1 after, in every save action

fields.name: resumed_flag
fields.meaning: 1 when this power-on found a valid key and is resuming; 0 for a new session (the value stored in the image is from the session that saved and is overwritten at boot)
fields.evidence: code 8000:00D5 (write), 8C79:04B8 (menu after-save state tests it)

fields.name: system_area_a
fields.meaning: Not decoded: sound, timers and task bookkeeping
fields.evidence: changes on most play steps

fields.name: frame_counter
fields.meaning: Frame counter increased by the vertical blank interrupt; used to time the main loop
fields.evidence: code 8026:01AC-01B9 (write), 8000:0103 (main loop wait); increases on every play step

fields.name: tick_counter
fields.meaning: Second counter increased every interrupt
fields.evidence: code 8026:01F1 (increment); increases on every play step

fields.name: system_area_b
fields.meaning: Not decoded: display, input and task records of the running screens
fields.evidence: changes with screens and input

fields.name: menu_task
fields.meaning: Record of the in-game function menu: +0 state word (0x0BC2 board cursor during play, 0x07D0 menu list open, 0x0A28 confirm dialog, 0x1B58 saved and halted), +6 active flag (1 while the menu runs), +0x12 menu flag (0 in game, 0xFFFF menu open, 0x0020 after save), +0x14 menu tag (3 while open), +0x16 cursor item (0-7, 5 = save-and-quit). This is why a resumed game reopens with the menu on screen
fields.evidence: code 8C79:0122 menu handler (item 5 writes the key, sets the halt flag, parks state 0x1B58), 8C79:04B8 (state 0x1B58 returns to the game when resuming); cursor tracked 0 to 5 across menu navigation, state tracked through list, dialog and save

fields.name: unknown_0a2c
fields.meaning: Not decoded; part of it differs between 9-line and 13-line games
fields.evidence: 9-line vs 13-line image diff

fields.name: board
fields.meaning: The Go board as shown on screen: one byte per point, 0 empty, 1 black, 2 white, 0xFF off the board. Point (x, y) is at 0x0AE9 + 19*y + x with x = 0 the left column and y = 0 the bottom row as shown; rows are 19 bytes long whatever the board size, the unused part of each row and the unused rows are 0xFF
fields.evidence: empty, one-stone, two-stone and 2-stone-handicap-plus-reply games (stone bytes at the expected offsets, handicap stones match the screenshot corners); row padding 19 - size from code 8B26:0B82; 13-line game uses the same origin

fields.name: board_guard
fields.meaning: 59 bytes of 0xFF plus one zero byte; set when a game starts, zero before. Likely board-fill overflow or guard area
fields.evidence: zero on title/setup screens, FF pattern in every in-game and suspended image; game-start transition writes it

fields.name: board_copy_1
fields.meaning: Second copy of the board in the same layout and origin, but off-board bytes are 0x00 instead of 0xFF; stone bytes match the main board exactly
fields.evidence: two-stone and handicap games (same stone offsets as the board, zero padding)

fields.name: copy1_tail
fields.meaning: Zero padding after the first board copy
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: unknown_0e00
fields.meaning: Not decoded (includes buffers for the link-cable game settings)
fields.evidence: code 8A24:033B (settings packet, 6 bytes, type 4), 8A24:038A (receive buffer)

fields.name: size_record_ptr
fields.meaning: Far pointer to the cartridge record for the chosen board size (offset 0x000C for 9 lines, 0x001E for 13 lines, segment 0xC1BE); word +8 of that record is the line count
fields.evidence: code 8A24:01BA (= 0x0C + 18*size index), defaults 8937:0010; 9-line vs 13-line images; cartridge records verified (+8 = 9 / 13)

fields.name: play_mode
fields.meaning: Play mode; 0 in every save made against the computer (another value is set by the title menu, probably the two-player link mode)
fields.evidence: code 8937:002D (default 0), clock code skips link mode; 0 in all 120 images

fields.name: reserved_1554
fields.meaning: Reserved; zero in every save image
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: music_on
fields.meaning: Background music switch from the settings screen (1 = on): when 0 the tune is not started
fields.evidence: code 8937:097E/09BA (music start skipped when 0); default 1 at 8937:0010

fields.name: sound_effects_on
fields.meaning: Sound effect switch from the settings screen (1 = on)
fields.evidence: code 8937:096A (sound call skipped when 0); default 1 at 8937:0010

fields.name: black_is_computer
fields.meaning: Who plays black: 0 = the player, 1 = the computer
fields.evidence: code 8A24:01C1 (from setup screen), 8B26:02CD (xor with the side to move); player-black vs computer-black games

fields.name: com_level
fields.meaning: Computer strength, 0-3 shown as level 1-4
fields.evidence: code 8A24:01C7, clamp 0..3 at 8A24:023B-024F; level 1 vs level 2 games

fields.name: board_size_index
fields.meaning: Board size choice: 0 = 9 lines, 1 = 13 lines
fields.evidence: code 8A24:01CD, clamp 0..1 at 8A24:0255-0269; 9-line vs 13-line games

fields.name: handicap_index
fields.meaning: Handicap choice 0-9: 0 = even game (komi 6), 1 = no komi, 2-9 = that many handicap stones
fields.evidence: code 8A24:01D3, clamp 0..9; cartridge table at C1C4:0000 verified (0,6),(0,0),(2,0)..(9,0); even-game vs 2-stone-handicap games

fields.name: setting_5
fields.meaning: Fifth setup value sent with the link-cable settings; default 10; meaning not decoded
fields.evidence: code 8937:0010 (default 10), 8A24:0358 (packed into link settings); 10 in all 120 images

fields.name: music_state
fields.meaning: Current tune number, its length, a copy of the music switch and a countdown to restart it
fields.evidence: code 8937:098B-0A31 (tune, length, switch copy, decrementing countdown)

fields.name: clock_running
fields.meaning: 1 while a player's clock is running, 0 when stopped (menus, end of game)
fields.evidence: code 8937:0137, 8937:060B-0625; 1 during play, 0 with the menu open

fields.name: clock_side
fields.meaning: Whose clock is counting: 0 = black, 1 = white, 0xFFFF = none
fields.evidence: code 8937:013D (set FFFF), 8937:0235 (used as index); black-to-move vs white-to-move vs menu-open images

fields.name: black_time
fields.meaning: Black's total thinking time in frames (about 75 per second), shown as hh:mm:ss
fields.evidence: code 8937:023D (add 1 per frame), 8937:01BF (display, divides into hours/minutes/seconds); grows during black's thinking, matches the on-screen clock

fields.name: white_time
fields.meaning: White's total thinking time in frames
fields.evidence: code 8937:023D; grows during white's thinking across games

fields.name: anim_channel_a
fields.meaning: Stone/blink animation channel: enable flag, two selectors, a toggle, a countdown from 150 frames that reloads, and a trigger flag. Idle (0) with the menu open, running during play
fields.evidence: code 8937:0633 (tick: decrement, fire at 149/74/0), 8937:07DC (start: enable, timer = 0x96), 8937:07B7/080B (stop); menu-open vs in-play images

fields.name: anim_channel_b
fields.meaning: Second animation channel (enable, selector, 150-frame countdown); same code shape as channel A. Zero in every save image
fields.evidence: code 8937:081E-095D (same tick/start/stop shape); zero in all 120 images

fields.name: move_count
fields.meaning: Number of moves played (passes included, handicap stones excluded); the undo command takes 2 off
fields.evidence: code 8B26:02D4 (add per move), 8C79:0550-055C (undo -2), 89DA:0002 (0 at game start); 0, 1 and 2-move games; handicap game shows 1 move with 3 stones

fields.name: rec1_head
fields.meaning: Record tag byte; zero
fields.evidence: code 89DA:0010 (block clear); zero in all 120 images

fields.name: rec1_board
fields.meaning: Board copy in the first game-record block, same layout and origin, but off-board bytes are 0x00; stone bytes match the main board
fields.evidence: two-stone and handicap games (same stone offsets, zero padding)

fields.name: rec1_tail
fields.meaning: Zero padding at the end of the first record block
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: spare_1731
fields.meaning: Spare byte between the record blocks; zero
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: rec2_head
fields.meaning: Record tag byte; zero
fields.evidence: code 89DA:001B (block clear); zero in all 120 images

fields.name: last_move_marker
fields.meaning: Highlight board in the second game-record block, same 19-wide layout: after move N a single byte 100+N sits at the played point (even before the stone appears on the main board while the computer is moving), 0 elsewhere. At move 0 an even game is all zero; a handicap game shows the handicap stones as plain stones until the first move
fields.evidence: holds on all 120 images (101 after move 1, 102 after move 2, 105 after move 5; pending computer move visible before the stone lands); code 8E32:0003 uses the same +100 marking on its search board

fields.name: rec2_tail
fields.meaning: Zero padding at the end of the second record block
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: gap_18d7
fields.meaning: Zero padding byte
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: side_to_move
fields.meaning: Colour to move: 1 = black, 2 = white
fields.evidence: code 89DA:0020 (1 at start); black-to-move, white-to-move and handicap (white first) games

fields.name: unknown_18da
fields.meaning: Two words set to 2 and 1 at game start, 0 before; not decoded
fields.evidence: code 89DA:0026/002C; constant in every in-game image

fields.name: board_lines
fields.meaning: Board size in lines (9 or 13), copied from the board size record
fields.evidence: code 89DA:003A (from record +8); 9-line vs 13-line games

fields.name: handicap_stones
fields.meaning: Number of handicap stones from the handicap table
fields.evidence: code 89DA:004F (table +0); 0 in even games, 2 in the 2-stone-handicap game

fields.name: komi
fields.meaning: Komi in whole points from the handicap table (6 for an even game, 0 otherwise)
fields.evidence: code 89DA:0067 (table +2); 6 in even games, 0 in the handicap game

fields.name: game_counters
fields.meaning: Ten words cleared at game start (one set to 1); probably captured-stone counts and pass/end flags; not separated
fields.evidence: code 89DA:006A-00A6; identical in every in-game image (no captures happened)

fields.name: reserved_18f8
fields.meaning: Reserved; zero in every save image
fields.evidence: zero in all 120 save images

fields.name: com_random
fields.meaning: Random number used by the computer player
fields.evidence: code 8E32:0153 (seed), 8E32:015D (next step, +0x3039, mod 0x7FFF); differs after computer moves

fields.name: com_random_calls
fields.meaning: Number of random draws since seeding
fields.evidence: code 8E32:0156 (clear), 8E32:015F (add); 0 before the computer moves, higher later

fields.name: work_area
fields.meaning: Large working area: search boards and lists of the computer player, move lists and display buffers (many board-shaped tables change after each move, including the computer's chosen point and +100 search marks). Not decoded field by field; the game needs all of it to resume
fields.evidence: changes after every move; code 8E32:0003/8000:FE81 (search marks at 0x2826, chosen point at 0x8F36)

fields.name: unused
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: code 8000:0064 (clear range ends at 0xCAD4); zero in every image

fields.name: stack
fields.meaning: Processor stack area; contents are left over from the moment of saving and are not used on resume (the stack pointer is reset at power-on)
fields.evidence: code 8000:0012 (stack pointer set to 0xFAE0)

fields.name: unused_high
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero (cartridge memory is 1 Mbit, the game only uses the first 64 KB window)
fields.evidence: zero in every image

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: Not written by this game (only the console owner data is there); identical before and after saving
fields.evidence: identical bytes in boot, suspended and in-play images

values.value: not written by this game (console owner data only)
